# Write interface copy for real states

Explain what happened, what it means and what the user can do next.

[All skills](index.md) · [Collection overview](../../README.md) · [Research and inspiration](../../standards/framework-evidence.md)

## When to use it

Use for labels, errors, empty states, progress messages and dashboard wording.

Example request:

> Write the interrupted-export message using the actual state contract; do not imply the download completed.

Expected result: State-accurate interface wording, consistent action names and useful recovery.

## A concrete example

This illustrative example starts from the source facts below.

**Source facts and constraints:** The export stopped before completion. The product supports trying again.

**Before**

> Export success: processing incomplete.

**After**

> Your export stopped before completion. Try again.

## Install and use

Install this skill from the versioned collection in a supported Agent Skills environment:

```sh
npx skills add https://github.com/theGeekist/skills/tree/v1.6.0 --skill write-interface-content
```

Select the intended agent and installation scope when prompted. This CLI installation is separate from ChatGPT plugin registration and mobile availability. Client discovery and activation require their own verification.

Read the [complete skill instructions](../../skills/write-interface-content/SKILL.md) and [bundled purpose reference](../../skills/write-interface-content/references/interface-content.md) for the full conditions and exceptions.
